critical_action_checklist.criterion: Introduce self with name and role

critical_action_checklist.evidence: Asked why the patient was there

critical_action_checklist.criterion: Explore history of present illness (HPI) using OLDCARTS
critical_action_checklist.evidence: Asked about onset, location, duration, character, alleviating/aggravating factors, radiation, timing, and severity

critical_action_checklist.criterion: Ask about relevant past medical history
critical_action_checklist.evidence: Asked about medical conditions, surgical history, and hospitalizations
Asked about medications, allergies, and drug allergies
Asked about family history of headaches

critical_action_checklist.criterion: Explore social history (smoking, alcohol, occupation, living situation)
critical_action_checklist.evidence: Asked about smoking, alcohol, marital status, children.

critical_action_checklist.criterion: Ask about impact on daily life
critical_action_checklist.evidence: Asked how the headache was impacting the patient's daily life
Asked about the patient's perception of what's going on and their concerns. Patient mentions fear of brain tumor.
The student summarized the history to ensure accuracy.

critical_action_checklist.criterion: Explain the plan for the consultation
critical_action_checklist.evidence: Explained the plan to do a physical exam and look into insurance
The student did eventually ask if there were any other questions after feedback from the SP.

FosteringRelationship.comment: The student was warm, friendly, and showed good rapport. Noticed patient concerns and offered solutions about insurance and secretary follow up. The student could show more empathy by acknowledging the patient's distress and validating their feelings and fears with more empathic statements throughout the interview.

GatheringInformation.comment: The student gathered a comprehensive history using OLDCARTS and asked about relevant medical, family, and social history. The student asked the patient if they had other complaints.

ProvidingInformation.comment: The student explained the plan for the consultation and what they would be doing. The student could have signposted more.

HelpingPatientDecisions.comment: The student elicited the patient's ICE. Could have discussed differential and safety netting.

feedback_summary: The student demonstrated strong communication skills and gathered a comprehensive history. The student was friendly, warm, and showed rapport with the patient. The student could improve by showing more empathy throughout the interview and explicitly checking for additional questions at the end of the interview.
